<thought>Based on the monoisotopic peak at m/z 121.0528 and the isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 8 % and M+2 ≈ 0.5 %), the formula that best matches is C₈H₉O. The 8 carbons give the observed ~8 % M+1 intensity, and the small M+2 intensity is consistent with contributions from two ¹³C atoms and ¹⁸O. No halogen or other hetero‑atoms are required.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H9O</final_answer>
